notes: Full description: LintRunner (pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:446) does not implement Debug. The struct holds Vec<Box<dyn Lint>> which cannot be Debug-derived automatically (Box<dyn Lint> requires Lint: Debug). However, a manual Debug impl showing the lint IDs (the stable string from Lint::id()) would be straightforward and valuable for diagnostics. Without Debug, LintRunner cannot appear in #[derive(Debug)] structs that contain it, and cannot be printed with {:?} in logs or test failures. Fix: add 'Debug' to the Lint trait bound (fn fmt showing id() list) or add a manual impl Debug for LintRunner that formats as 'LintRunner { lints: ["id1", "id2", ...], bundle_version: "..."}'. The Lint trait already has Send + Sync bounds, adding Debug to the trait bound is a breaking change for existing Lint implementors.
title: RUSTY: LintRunner missing Debug impl
